subject: Switching inference provider — technical review & demo scheduling
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@novatek.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Navarro <alex@novatek.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Switching inference provider — request for technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the chat last week. Were moving ahead with an evaluation to replace our current inference stack (self-hosted + third-party routing) and would like a technical deep-dive to validate performance and migration risks before committing to a PoC.

High-level asks for the session:
- 45-60 minute architecture review + short demo of runtime behavior under live-ish load
- Coverage: model variants, quantization tradeoffs, KV cache behavior, warm-starts, and estimated uplift/cost trajectory for our workload
- Attendees from our side: myself (Head of AI Eng) and Alex (Platform lead)

Would you and someone from the infra/runtime team be available this week? Were in PDT (San Francisco). Preferable windows: Tue Jun 15 10:00-12:00 or Wed Jun 16 14:00-16:00. If those dont work, we can expand.

Thanks — Priya

Priya Shah
Head of AI Engineering | Novatek AI
pri...@novatek.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Navarro <alex@novatek.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Switching inference provider — request for technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Priya 

Appreciate the detail — we can definitely cover the items you listed. Suggested agenda (45 mins + 15 for Q&A):
1) Quick intro & goals (5 min)
2) Runtime architecture: batching, KV cache, and warm-start strategy (10 min)
3) Quantization & model variant tradeoffs (10 min)
4) Demo: synthetic load + memory/latency profile (10 min)
5) Migration plan + ROC/rollback options for a PoC (10 min)

I can run the demo and bring Jonas (runtime lead) to speak to ops/rollout. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-15 10:30-11:30
- Wed 2027-06-16 14:30-15:15 (shorter slot)

Please confirm which works or propose an alternate. Im attaching a brief architecture summary that might be a helpful pre-read.

Attachment: redwood-arch-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Adding a couple quick ops items from our side.

Priya, thanks for the windows — both look workable, but can we bias toward Tue 10:30 if thats still possible? That gives us time to stand up a short synthetic run that mirrors your avg seq length and batching distribution. Also if you have a short prompt sample and expected p95 latency target thatd be helpful pre-read so we can tailor the demo.

On agenda content: please let us know if you want us to include a short section on fallback policies (model variant routing + graceful degradation) and on customer-side network egress constraints. Well also bring the minimal runbook for the PoC so your platform team can review the cutover steps.

On logistics: if Tue 10:30-11:30 works, well send a calendar invite and include a pre-read link (arch summary + quick runbook).

Jonas Weber
